subject: Next steps: 30-minute product intro — proposed demo windows & stakeholders
body:
--- MESSAGE 1 (May 26, 2026 — 11:02 AM PDT) ---
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acmehealth.com>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@acmehealth.com>
Cc:
Date: Wed, May 26, 2026 at 11:02 AM -0700
Subject: Next steps: 30-minute product intro — proposed demo windows & stakeholders

Hi Sara & Tom,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — really helpful to understand Acme Health's ingestion patterns and the latency/cost targets you're working toward. Quick recap: key priorities for the pilot are low 95th%-ile latency for short prompts (~<300 tokens), strict data residency for PHI workflows, and an ops path for autoscaling during peak claim processing windows.

To keep momentum, we'd like to schedule a 30-minute product intro focused on how Redwood Inference maps to the priorities above (runtime architecture, deployment options, and a short Q&A). I pulled together three initial windows (all in PT):
- Tue, Jun 1 — 09:00–09:30 PT
- Wed, Jun 2 — 11:00–11:30 PT
- Thu, Jun 3 — 14:00–14:30 PT

Please let me know which of the three works best and who from your side should attend (we recommend the product owner + one technical stakeholder). If those don't work, tell me two preferred timebands and I’ll propose alternates.

Attached: discovery-notes-acme.pdf (brief call notes) and a draft 30m-demo-agenda (agenda doc). I’ll loop in Grace from CS and Priyom from our infra team once we lock a time so they can prep any targeted infrastructure examples.

Proposed success criteria for the session:
- Confirm fit for a short pilot (SLA & cost targets)
- Identify required stakeholders and next steps for procurement/security review
- Agree on a follow-up technical deep dive if needed

Next steps: confirm slot + attendees.

Thanks,
Ethan Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

--- MESSAGE 2 (May 26, 2026 — 11:28 AM PDT) ---
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acmehealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@acmehealth.com>
Cc:
Date: Wed, May 26, 2026 at 11:28 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: 30-minute product intro — proposed demo windows & stakeholders

Thanks Ethan — good summary.

Jun 1 at 09:00 PT looks tight for Tom (exec travel), but Jun 3 at 14:00 PT should work for our product lead (Tom) and I can join.

Attendees on our side:
- Tom Bennett (Product Lead) — will attend if Jun 3 works
- Sara Lopez (IT Security lead) — will join for the first ~20 min to confirm residency/controls

Can you confirm the agenda (especially time for security questions) and whether you need any pre-call artifacts beyond the discovery notes?

Sara
Sara Lopez
Head of IT Security | Acme Health
sara.lopez@acmehealth.com

--- MESSAGE 3 (May 26, 2026 — 12:10 PM PDT) ---
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acmehealth.com>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, May 26, 2026 at 12:10 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: 30-minute product intro — proposed demo windows & stakeholders

Perfect — thank you, Sara. Locking Jun 3, 14:00–14:30 PT tentatively. Grace (CS) and Priyom (infra) are cc'd — Grace will handle logistics and the calendar invitation; Priyom will be on the call for any infra/security questions.

Quick agenda (30 min):
1) 3 min — introductions & goals for the session
2) 12 min — product walkthrough (runtime, hosting modes, and how we meet residency/SLA needs)
3) 8 min — security & deployment Q&A (Priyom + Sara)
4) 5 min — next steps & mutual action items (pilot scope, timeline, contacts)

Prep: nothing heavy — the discovery notes I attached cover the call. If you can share any additional compliance checklists or a short list of sample traffic profiles (peak TPS/token lengths), Priyom can pull a quick mapping for runtime/instance sizing.

I’ll send a calendar invite in a moment (calendar link: https://calendar.redwoodinference.com/b/abc123-demo-slot). Grace, can you take the invite + Ops checklist?

Thanks — see you Jun 3.
Ethan

--- MESSAGE 4 (May 26, 2026 — 12:36 PM PDT) ---
From: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@acmehealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, May 26, 2026 at 12:36 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: 30-minute product intro — proposed demo windows & stakeholders

Jun 3rd @ 14:00 PT works for me. Looking forward to the short walkthrough; please include 5–7 minutes to talk about predictable performance under burst (95th percentile). Also please send any short pre-read you want me to glance at.

Tom Bennett
Product Lead | Acme Health

--- End of thread ---
